turns.prompt_text: What's a good place in Ankeny that I could go out to eat tonight? It's already 9pm.
turns.response_html:
At 9 PM on a Tuesday in Ankeny, your best bets are late-night grills and pubs, as many standard restaurants have already closed or are closing at 10 PM.

Open Late (Past 11 PM)

Yankee Clipper Since it is Tuesday, this neighborhood standby is a top recommendation because of its well-known Taco Tuesday special. It is a classic local spot that stays open late, making it a reliable choice for a relaxed meal when other kitchens have closed.

  • Open until: 2:00 AM
  • Known for: "Lauded" Taco Tuesday specials and classic bar fare.
  • Atmosphere: Casual, neighborhood bar vibe with patio seating.

Whiskey River Ankeny If you are looking for a full menu in a slightly more modern setting, Whiskey River is a great option. It offers a broad menu of American grill standards and is one of the few places in Ankeny that keeps its kitchen open late into the night.

  • Open until: 2:00 AM
  • Highlights: Extensive craft beer list and "industrial-chic" decor.
  • Menu: Features hearty appetizers, burgers, and grill favorites.

Open Until 11 PM (Head there soon)

Anchors Away You still have time to grab a table here if you head over soon. It is a highly-rated local favorite offering a solid food menu in a nautical-themed environment.

  • Open until: 11:00 PM
  • Vibe: Friendly and lively bar and grill atmosphere.
  • Food: Known for good pub food and drinks.

Dave's Hot Chicken For something quick and casual without the "bar" atmosphere, Dave's is open for another couple of hours. It is a newer spot in town specializing in Nashville-style hot chicken.

  • Open until: 11:00 PM
  • Specialty: Hot chicken sliders and tenders (spice levels range from "No Spice" to "Reaper").
  • Setting: Counter-service fast casual.

Note: Popular spots like 30hop and Boulder Tap House are listed as closing at 10:00 PM tonight, so their kitchens may already be closing down.
